## Autumn at Café Mars

###### We have changed 8 dishes and still have 3 new ones to come as we transition from the Summer to the Fall and Winter. Come try them the new ones we have and stay tuned for the new ones to come! 

###### Just like every year, we will celebrate the holidays with our version of Feast of the Seven Fishes and this year the theme is "An Italian Island Christmas," taking inspiration from the islands of Italy--both physical and metaphorical. Full announcement and reservation information coming in late November!

###### For more detailed updates, follow us [on IG: **@cafemarsbk**](https://www.instagram.com/cafemarsbk/?hl=en "@cafemarsbk") or join our mailing list.
